title: OpenAI Dots and Jev: supervise an inbox workflow
description: Supervise a Dots-assisted inbox with a separate Jev screening worker, reviewable drafts and explicit failures. Check product access, API costs and approval boundaries.

source.title: OpenAI Dots: Run GPT-6 Astra 24/7 and become a solo dev who Just Supervises (Full Guide)

guide_authors.name: Appit Studio
guide_authors.role: Editorial guide; AI-assisted drafting and offline technical verification

connections.step: Screen bounded email threads into code-owned queue, check and skip buckets before preparing a morning review packet
connections.why: The inspected Python project separates seven parallel Jev judgments from deterministic queue policy and preserves selected answer fields. It teaches the article’s inbox-screening step; Noisy does not name it, and it has no writer or Dots adapter.
connections.limitations: MIT open-source, free source build, BYOK. Python 3.10+, uv and billed TypeSafe access; real inbox needs IMAP access. Synthetic demo input still triggers live requests when uncached. Cache identity omits model version; no reply writer or Dots connector. Eight authored policy fixtures passed; no mailbox or inference run.

faqs.question: Can I add Jev directly to OpenAI Dots?
faqs.answer: The inspected sources do not establish a built-in Jev router inside Dots. Run Jev in a separate worker and expose a bounded report or tool through a separately verified integration; Dots permissions and action review still apply.

faqs.question: Does the Jev Inbox Queue demo run offline?
faqs.answer: Its input is synthetic, but uncached threads still call TypeSafe. Use injected response fixtures for a genuinely offline policy replay; a cached or demo run does not by itself prove no data transfer or charges.

faqs.question: Does one million Jev decisions cost $42?
faqs.answer: Only under the assumption of 1,000 input tokens per decision at $0.042 per million tokens. Count state and questions, retries and other services separately; a decision is not a fixed billing unit.

faqs.question: Can Jev approve an email send?
faqs.answer: No. Jev can judge supplied evidence, but application code checks permissions and binds the final action to a human approval. A high probability or confidence does not authorize sending.
